description.narrative: The International Development Association (IDA) is an international financial institution which offers concessional loans and grants to the world's poorest developing countries. IDA is a member of the World Bank Group and complements the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development by lending to developing countries which suffer from the lowest gross national income, from troubled creditworthiness, or from the lowest per capita income. Funding under this initiative represents a contribution to IDA19 debt arrears clearance, which is a mechanism for IDA eligible countries in arrears in repayments to re-engage with the World Bank under certain circumstances. The total value of this initiative is $4.63 million to be expensed over the period 2020-21-2022-23.
